description: Prices an Errands brief from the call rate sheet, including the ai_task minute. Returns the caller ID and the cost at max_call_minutes. No rate refuses the call. Emergency and premium-rate numbers are refused. A marketing brief is refused. The seat needs the current Errands terms. A bad brief lists every missing and invalid field at once. This does not dial.

allowed_commitments.description: The only things the assistant may agree to, e.g. 'accept any slot Tue–Thu after 14:00'. For anything else it says it will check and come back, and lists it in the report. Payments, contracts and cancellations are never allowed.

assistant_name.description: Optional. The name the assistant uses on this call instead of the AI assistant settings name.

callee_is_business.description: Optional. True when the callee is a business.

callee_name.description: Who you are calling, e.g. 'FedEx UK Import Clearance' or 'Dr Cohen's clinic'.

caller_identity_id.description: Optional. You may set it. If you omit it, Widely picks the caller ID. If you set it, it must be an identity_id from list_identities, one of the user's own. Never invent another number.

connect_user.description: When true, the assistant asks the callee to hold at the end, rings the user's phones into the call, and leaves.

destination.description: Number to call, E.164 (+44…, +972…, +1…) or local. Emergency and premium-rate numbers are refused.

facts_to_collect.description: Questions to ask and the information to bring back.

description.description: The question to ask or the information needed.

facts_to_give.description: Facts the assistant may give. Card numbers, CVVs, PINs and passwords are refused.

forbidden.description: Things the assistant must not say or agree to.

goal.description: The outcome you want, in one or two sentences.

if_unknown.description: What to do when asked something the brief does not cover.

language.description: BCP-47 such as en-GB or he-IL, or auto-from-seat.

on_behalf_of.description: Who the call is for. person is required.

company.description: Company, if the call is for a business.

person.description: Name of the person the call is for.

opening_line.description: Optional. What to say first, after the assistant introduces itself and plays the mandatory notice.

purpose_category.description: Kind of call. Marketing, sales, surveys, debt collection, political and fundraising calls are refused.

save_as_default.description: With assistant_name, also save it as the default name in Widely AI assistant settings.

schedule_at.description: When to call, ISO date-time, at most 14 days ahead. Omit it to call now.

success_criteria.description: How to tell the call worked, e.g. 'they confirm the delivery date'.

time_window.description: Optional calling window, at least 10 minutes long and within 14 days. The call is placed inside it.

voicemail.description: On voicemail: leave_message (default), hang_up_and_retry (uses limits.retry), or hang_up.

voicemail_message.description: Optional. If absent, the assistant leaves a short message from the goal and on_behalf_of, with no sensitive facts.

name: quote_call_task
title: Quote an Errands call
